legacy.description: Cleveland, The Cleveland Museum of Art, Exhibition of American Painting from 1860 Until Today at The Cleveland Museum of Art (23 June-4 October 1937), cat. no. 40.

description: Henry Golden Dearth's composition presents a farm worker guiding a pair of workhorses after a day of harvesting grain. The painting's title refers the short pieces of grain stalks left in the ground after the crop has been cut.
